title: Half-term recitation: Ya-Sin 25 to 67 against the rubric: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 38 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Half-term recitation rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 38. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ (٦٥) وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ (٦٦) وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ (٦٧)

وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ (٦٨) وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ (٦٩) لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ (٧٠)

questions.q: Whole class recites 36:65 to 67 together, then the teacher recites 36:68 to 70 for home hifdh.
Recitation: today's group recites Ya-Sin 25 to 67 to the teacher against the rubric. Everyone else: manzil rota and the home hifdh plan.
Which of these ayat contains the saktah?
Think again: Ya-Sin 68 to 70 are learned at home this half term. How will you make sure you learn them correctly without a teacher listening every day?
questions.a: Listen to the teacher's recitation first, use the 3-3-link, recite to a parent with the mushaf and book a check.
